newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian call money in 2.5-3.0 pct range, seen easy.
newsitem.headline: Indian call money in 2.5-3.0 pct range, seen easy.

text.p: Indian call money was traded in the 2.50-3.0 percent range in early deals on Thursday, little changed from the previous day's close, dealers said.
Call money rates are expected to remain in the same range on Thursday, they said.
"Call money seems to have stabilised below three percent," a dealer at a foreign bank said. "There appears to be a good supply of funds in the market while demand is not so strong."
Dealers said they expected increased buying interest in securities as call money rates had stabilised at low levels.
"At current rates, banks may be interested in picking up short-dated securities, particularly treasury bills," said a dealer.

"But there may not be much interest in longer-dated securities as banks are still unable to forecast liquidity conditions accurately....they would not like to lock up funds for longer periods," he said.
